experiment: 2022-2025 availability harmonization V4 official-club postseason source audit
closeout_reason: The identity source covered the preregistered postseason team-weeks, but a deterministic complete official-club final injury-report row source could not be established for every affected matchup. The contract forbade inferring healthy status from absence, mixing incomplete narrative pages into row-level state, or relaxing the 1.0 fallback qualification requirement. V4 therefore terminated before model fitting or availability qualification.

blocking_matchups.reason: No deterministic complete final row table for both clubs was established under the official-club source audit.
The audited Lions final page was Detroit-only and no deterministically captured complete complementary Washington row table was established.
The audited Bills material was narrative/embedded-report oriented rather than a complete machine-readable row table, with no complementary complete official-club row source established.

terminal_policy: Do not create another postseason rescue version solely to force qualification. Reopen only if a new, independently verifiable, complete official historical source is identified for every blocking matchup before downstream qualification metrics are inspected.
relationship_to_regular_season_v2: Preserved unchanged. The regular-season v2 contract is a separate audit of the pre-existing LevLine model universe, which filters postseason games before matchup-feature evaluation.
